div.head: Ine 28
div.ab: Se (þe) ðeof gefehð, he ah X scll', ⁊ se cyning þone ðeof; ⁊ þa magas him swerian aþas unfehþa.
LXXII. Se ðeof gefehð, ah X scill., ⁊ se cyning ðone ðeof; ⁊ þa mægas him swerian aðas unfæhða.
Qui furem ceperit, habeat inde decem solidos, et rex ipsum furem; et parentes eius abiurent ei factionem.
{LXXII} Se ðeof gefehð, ah X sciƚƚ, ⁊ se cyning ðone ðeof; ⁊ þa mægas him swerian aðas unfæhða.
He who catches a thief receives 10 shillings, and the king the thief; and his kinsmen swear oaths to renounce feuding.
He who captures a thief shall have 10 shillings. The thief shall be given up to the king, and his kinsmen shall swear that they will carry on no vendetta against him.
He who captures a thief has a right to 10 shillings, and the king to the thief; and the kinsmen are to swear to him oaths that they will wage no feud.
Wer einen Dieb [bei der That] fängt, [der] erhält 10 Schill., und der König den Dieb; und die Verwandten [des Diebes] sollen jenem [Einfänger] Urfehde-Eide schwören.
Whoever catches a thief [in the act] receives 10 shillings, and the king the thief; and the kinsmen [of the thief] are to swear oaths of renouncing feud to that [captor].
